generate_question_vectors: generate question embedding vectors from a list of questions using a biencoder model and batch size
create_dense_retriever: create a DenseRetriever instance with a question encoder, batch size, and QA source for dense retrieval
index_encoded_data_local_faiss: index encoded passage vectors into a local Faiss index from a list of pickle files with a given buffer size
get_top_docs_local_faiss: retrieve top matching passages from a local Faiss index given query vectors and number of top documents
load_remote_index: load and connect to a remote distributed Faiss index server for dense retrieval with configurable nprobe and L2 metric
